prompt: We need to make our healthcare patient portal accessible. We have elderly patients who may have low vision, and some patients who use screen readers. What should we check?

assertions.text: Addresses color contrast ratios with WCAG AA/AAA standards for healthcare
Covers screen reader compatibility and ARIA attributes
Addresses keyboard navigation and focus management
Includes elderly-specific considerations (tap targets, text sizing, motor control)
Produces a structured accessibility audit report with prioritized remediation
Includes healthcare-specific accessibility concerns (medical terminology, emergency states)
